mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, email, display_name, password_hash, status, platform_role, last_login_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND identity_type = 'PHONE' AND issuer = 'local' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_identity(id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, 'PHONE', 'local', #{phone}, #{phone}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (identity_type, issuer, normalized_identifier) DO NOTHING
